opening_hook: What if your biggest regret wasn't failure, but never starting?
narration: What if your biggest regret wasn't failure, but never starting? Meet Rohan. He was drowning in distractions and procrastination. Every morning, he promised himself he'd start studying, but the phone always won. His marks were slipping, and his confidence was shattered. The turning point came when he saw his younger brother working late every night. Rohan realized his excuses were costing him his future. He deleted his social media apps and set a strict 5 AM alarm. It was brutal. The first week, he wanted to quit. But he pushed through. Slowly, his grades improved, and his self-belief returned. Discipline isn't about being perfect; it's about showing up when no one is watching. Start small, stay consistent, and trust the process. Your future self will thank you.
